text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, I 
accepted Fuji Kiseki's invitation to watch 
a play at an outdoor theater, but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Truly magnificent... Your singing, your 
acting...! No, everything! Everything was 
simply marvelous...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. The lead actor is an acquaintance 
of my mother's, and they took great care 
of me when I was little."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I'd like to go say hello for a 
bit, if that's okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hello, long time no see.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Fuji-chan! You came to watch~♪ My, 
haven't you grown quite dashing since I 
last saw you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But seeing your performance 
today, I still don't hold a candle to you.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
My, you've gotten good at flattery, 
haven't you! So, who is the person next to 
you?

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
Ah. So you're Fuji-chan's... Huh... So 
you're the one, huh...

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
...This girl must be quite a handful for 
you, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Because! Back at the company, this girl 
was known as the 'Prankster Prince.'"

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
During rehearsal breaks, I'd dangle prop 
spiders from above and startle the cast 
members~!

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Well, thanks to the prince, there was 
never a dull moment, and it was quite a 
nice breath of fresh air."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that was a long time ago. Obviously, 
I don't do childish things like that 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? It's a bit of a shame that we 
won't get to see that adorable little 
prince.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, not you too, Trainer. Give me a 
break here!

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
You two get along so well♪ I'm glad I got 
to see that. Well then, I need to get 
changed soon, so...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My apologies. If you ever perform 
nearby again, I will definitely come to 
watch.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thank you. ...Oh, that's right. 
Trainer, do you have a moment to talk?

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, I really wanted that child 
to become an actor."

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
On the same stage someday—her as the lead 
and me supporting. Creating the ultimate 
performance together... Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I was feeling pretty gloomy 
about it... but talking to you cleared all 
those feelings right up."

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
...She had such a wonderful expression. 
I'm sure she found a place even better 
than the stage, and a wonderful partner.

text_block_list.name: Stage Actor
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please take good care of her. Our 
beloved treasure—we entrust her to you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back. ...So, what did you talk 
about?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Like having to listen to other 
embarrassing stories... or something?"
choice_data_list: They pointed out a lot of my weaknesses.
She just taught me how to enjoy the show

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I had a feeling that was it! So, 
what kind of story did you hear?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A secret, huh... Something that could 
become my weakness is... ah.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Could it be the story about how I hated 
wearing heels and threw a tantrum?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Judging by that reaction, nope...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she's talking about the curtains... 
Or maybe that thing that happened five 
times in a row...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever. Even if it was a 
mistake born of childhood innocence, 'my 
sin is my own,' as they say. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I doubt you'd go blabbing my 
secret to anyone, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silenced with just a simple wink... Fuji 
Kiseki certainly possesses all the 
qualities of a first-rate stage actor.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I see!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Do you really think I'll buy that? 
Lying doesn't suit you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Liars are usually the best at seeing 
through lies. And the greatest entertainer 
is also the most brilliant liar, after 
all.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Realizing I couldn't brush it off... I 
conveyed the shared feelings and entrusted 
wishes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: On the same stage as me, huh...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
True, that kind of future might have been 
possible. But...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I chose a different path. If that person 
can bless it and believe in me, then...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We've got to put on entertainment that 
surpasses even the show we saw today. 
—Right out there on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Together, let's produce the 
greatest 'Fuji Kiseki' ever!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stage isn't the only place to enchant 
the fans. Afterward, I headed home while 
discussing future plans with Fuji Kiseki.
